'''Solar Wind Eight''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Adumar]]. The pilot was ordered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to join the screen against the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] protecting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] capital [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Later the pilot tagged [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] downed starfighter and transmitted the coordinates to [[Allegiance (Imperial I-class)|''Allegiance'']], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]], for rescue.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
